mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sms_flash_promotion_product_relation (flash_promotion_id, flash_promotion_session_id, product_id, product_sku_id, flash_promotion_price, flash_promotion_count, flash_promotion_limit, sort, reserved_count, sold_count, stock_status) VALUES (#{flashPromotionId}, #{flashPromotionSessionId}, #{productId}, #{productSkuId}, #{flashPromotionPrice}, #{flashPromotionCount}, #{flashPromotionLimit}, #{sort}, 0, 0, 'PREPARING')
mapper.select: SELECT id, flash_promotion_id AS flashPromotionId, flash_promotion_session_id AS flashPromotionSessionId, product_id AS productId, product_sku_id AS productSkuId, flash_promotion_price AS flashPromotionPrice, flash_promotion_count AS flashPromotionCount, flash_promotion_limit AS flashPromotionLimit, sort, reserved_count AS reservedCount, sold_count AS soldCount, stock_status AS stockStatus FROM sms_flash_promotion_product_relation WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE sms_flash_promotion_product_relation SET stock_status='RECOVERY' WHERE id=#{id} AND stock_status IN ('PREPARING','READY') AND reserved_count=0 AND sold_count=0
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sms_flash_promotion_product_relation WHERE id = #{id} AND stock_status = 'RECOVERY' AND reserved_count = 0 AND sold_count = 0
